investment_strategy: Barbell within AI and large-cap tech quality. In a VIX ~20, 10Y ~4.23% environment with Nasdaq softness and headline risk (antitrust, AI regulation, geopolitics), overweight cash-generative AI platforms with durable moats and clear ROI, complemented by a smaller, high-upside allocation to the leading AI-accelerator supplier. Emphasize valuation discipline, strong balance sheets, and positive analyst conviction. Execution plan: scale in over 2–4 weeks to smooth volatility; 12–24 month horizon; quarterly rebalance; trim on ±20% dislocations vs. fundamentals; monitor policy/regulatory milestones and data center capex/power trends.
